Kimberly (legal) and Laura (contracts ops) are looped for intake and redline execution.

Let me know if that works.

Hi all — I'm Kimberly on Redwood Legal. A few initial notes after a quick scan of the MSA: 

1) Indemnity/Limitations: StratusLane's current proposed indemnity carve-outs in Section 7 look broader than Redwood standard (it attempts to include product defects language that shifts liability back to vendor). We'll propose a narrower customer-side indemnity and keep Redwood's liability cap aligned with fees.

2) Data retention and deletion: the MSA references indefinite logging for audit purposes. Please confirm anticipated retention windows for production logs and backups. If StratusLane requires extended retention beyond our standard 90 days for logs, note that in the party sheet.

3) SLA & Acceptance window: you mentioned a 30-day acceptance period in the SOW. For our standard Order Form we typically use a 14‑day acceptance window for discrete deliverables; happy to discuss.

4) Redline format: please accept changes as Track Changes in Word for the MSA and a clean copy plus annotated comments for the Order Form Excel. If you prefer a markup PDF, indicate that.

5) Security questionnaire / evidence: please provide the procurement contact and we'll send a secure link to the SOC2 and pen-test report. We prefer not to email sensitive evidence.

I'm attaching a short one‑pager that outlines clauses we usually negotiate commercially vs. legally — it'll speed the first pass.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
